prompt:
Write exactly four alternating dialogue turns, each on its own line and labelled with the speaker’s name. Use at most 100 words and no narration. Let the difference in voice emerge through word choice.

The ferry bell is cracked. Ada is a terse ferryman who refuses to sail. Lev is an anxious musician who needs a way to warn the village. They may agree to use Lev’s drum. Neither knows whether the village can hear them.
